**Who has access to what, why, and should they still?**


> Granting, reviewing and revoking access across systems and physical space: joiner provisioning, role changes, periodic recertification and leaver revocation. Access accumulates — the risk is almost never the grant, it is the grant that was never removed when the reason for it ended.
